title: Another Death Linked to Domestic Violence in Less Than A Week
article: First there was the fatal police shooting last Friday night of Eugene Knight, 46, when he held a knife to his wife's throat in their Vancouver apartment. The Integrated Homicide Investigation Team is investigating and still wants to talk to witnesses who can call 1-877-551- IHIT.
Now a Burnaby man has appeared in court, charged with the second-degree murder of his estranged wife Monday.

Oswill Vergara, 41, was arrested after police were called to the home he had once charged with his wife, a mother of five. The youngest children are believed to be from the relationship - so they have one parent dead and another in jail.
Amazing that there are such tragic cases as some of the community groups that work with battered women are losing their funding with all the cuts coming out of Victoria.
